before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 3 h 30 min of staff time per lease or amendment

steps.task: Pull the executed lease from email, file it, open an abstract record
Read the lease and exhibits end to end, tab the key clauses
Key the rent schedule and escalations into the property management system
Key CAM terms: pro-rata share, base year, caps, exclusions, gross-ups
Key options, critical dates, insurance, use and assignment clauses
Check every keyed field against the lease, page by page
Fix discrepancies and set critical-date reminders
Set up recurring charges and check the first invoice

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 20 min of human time per lease or amendment

steps.task: Watch the lease inbox, OCR the PDF, split body and exhibits, de-duplicate
Label the document type, match property, unit and tenant, route it
Pull 65 abstract fields in four groups, each with a page and clause citation
Check each field against its citation, apply amendments, score confidence
Recompute rent steps and escalations, check date order and square footage
Approve or correct flagged fields with the cited clause side by side
Post the approved abstract to the property management system, set reminders
Confirm the recurring charges before the first invoice runs
